name: Transfer Status 5 Choice
definition: Choice of statuses for the status of a transfer.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of the transfer is received, accepted, sent to next party, matched, already executed, or settled.

PendingSettlement.name: Pending Settlement
PendingSettlement.definition: Status of the transfer is pending settlement.

Unmatched.name: Unmatched
Unmatched.definition: Status of the transfer is unmatched.

InRepair.name: In Repair
InRepair.definition: Status of the transfer is in repair.

Rejected.name: Rejected
Rejected.definition: Status of the transfer is rejected.

FailedSettlement.name: Failed Settlement
FailedSettlement.definition: Status of the transfer is failed settlement, that is, settlement in the International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) or Central Securities Depository (CSD) failed.

Cancelled.name: Cancelled
Cancelled.definition: Status of the transfer is cancelled.

Reversed.name: Reversed
Reversed.definition: Status of the transfer is reversed.

CancellationPending.name: Cancellation Pending
CancellationPending.definition: Status of the transfer is cancellation pending.
